en: Vintage monochrome (blue‑tinted) postcard showing a tall statue of Dante Alighieri on a multi‑tiered pedestal in a park with trees and mountains behind. Decorative patriotic border elements featuring stars, foliage, allegorical figures, and a lion with a female figure appear around the central image. The upper right text reads "Trento Italiana," and next to the statue image is the caption "Monumento a DANTE ALIGHIERI."
